01Why now

Why this course, and why now

AI agents change both sides of security. They give attackers speed, and they add a new thing to defend: software that reads untrusted text and takes actions. This course covers the fundamentals first, then how to defend, test and govern in that world.

02Outcomes

What you will be able to do

Understand the risks

Explain how attacks work and where your own exposure is.

Secure the basics

Harden accounts, devices, networks and cloud services.

Test safely

Practise ethical hacking only in environments you own or are authorised to test.

Manage risk

Build a risk register and map controls to compliance needs, including for small businesses.

04The lab

A security review of a small business

Review a small business setup, practise attacks only in a lab you own, and write the plan. One project, built in steps after each lesson. Each step has instructions, a finished example, a health check, and saves on your device.

The steps

  1. List assets and what matters most
  2. Build a risk register
  3. Harden accounts and devices from a checklist
  4. Run an authorised exercise in your own practice lab
  5. Review one AI tool for data and injection risk
  6. Write the plan for the owner

What the health check looks for

  • Every risk has an owner and a control
  • The exercise was run only in a lab you own
  • The plan can be read by a non-technical owner

05How you learn

The same method as every Intellica course

See it done

Every lesson starts with a finished example, so you know what good looks like.

Do it yourself

Early steps are mostly filled in. Later steps give you a template, then a blank page.

Check your work

Questions bring back what you learned on a schedule, and a health check tells you if your lab work holds up.

Stay current

Courses are built from current research, with sources you can open, and revised when the evidence changes.

The method follows published research on retrieval practice, worked examples and spaced review. Read the evidence and sources.

06Certificate

A certificate you can verify and share

When you meet the criteria you can claim a certificate with its own credential ID and a public page anyone can open to verify it. Add it to LinkedIn in one click, share it, or save it as a PDF.

To earn it

  1. Finish every lesson
  2. Complete every lab step and pass its health checks
  3. Answer at least 70% of the check questions correctly, on the first try or in review

What you get

  • A credential ID and a public page that confirms it
  • Add to LinkedIn in one click
  • Share on LinkedIn, X or Facebook, or copy the link
  • Save as a PDF

Intellica certificates show that you finished this course. They are not accredited qualifications and do not lead to any outside certification.
